x: This left three starters and of these Khlopin soon retired. Martin led the field at the turn and eventually finished sixth in 2 hrs. 44 min. 31 sec.—a splendid first performance over this course, and distance.
Bentley, Martin, Khlopin and Allen—who scored our third successive win. We now hold winning team trophies for both the Walk and Relay over the Brighton course.

Of our lads at this time the two Freds—Bentley and Rickards—were together in tenth position, Martin fourteenth, and Paul Khlopin well up. Approaching Croydon, Whitlock drew level with Stone, and shortly afterwards went ahead.

Khlopin worked his way through to 7th and when they came into sight again was 5th but was unable to improve on his position.
